_about: LUCI: two burns in simulated lunar gravity on a spinning Blue Origin New Shepard rocket (Feb 2025). Every value cites the exact text on its PDF page of NTRS 20250010653; pipelines/luci.py fails the build if a text is not on its page or does not contain its value.

gravity.text: Blue Origin New Shepard sounding rocket yields Lunar gravity by using centrifugal acceleration.

pressure.text: Two samples are burned simultaneously in air at normal pressure

duration.value: over two and a half minutes
duration.text: the burn lasts for over two and a half minutes

coriolis.text: the Coriolis force pulls the flame away from the axis of the fuel

material_verbatim.text: SIBAL fabric (cotton-fiberglass blend) burning downward in Lunar-g

outcome.value: The flame spread for over a minute
outcome.text: The flame spread for over a minute.

runs.outcome_label: Spread steadily for over a minute

material_verbatim.text: a 4-mm diameter rod of acrylic plastic (polymethyl methacrylate)

size.text: a 4-mm diameter rod of acrylic plastic

direction.text: PMMA rod burning upward in air in Lunar-g

outcome.value: Total base spread of ~6cm until extinction
outcome.text: Total base spread of ~6cm until extinction.

runs.outcome_label: Spread about 6 cm, then went out
